QuestionStmt.S: If $L_n$ represents lanthanoid element, find the general formula of lanthanoid hydroxide.

Solution.S:
Lanthanoids generally exhibit a +3 oxidation state in their compounds.

Hydroxide ion carries a charge of −1, represented as OH⁻.

To form a neutral compound with Ln³⁺, three OH⁻ ions are needed to balance the +3 charge.

Hence, the general formula for lanthanoid hydroxide becomes Ln(OH)₃.

Among the given options, this corresponds to option C.
